## Code Review

This pull request adds the terminal decision JSON and three markdown reports detailing the results of the parser bakeoff campaign comparing Docling and MinerU, as well as updating the reports index. The review feedback suggests explicitly marking the omission of the self-hash in the terminal decision JSON, adding converted and failed fields to the MinerU lane for schema consistency, and correcting a formatting typo in a question ID within the MinerU report.
